shots.scene: Golden-hour beachfront pursuit: the hero car counter-steers through a PIT formation of three NBPD cruisers while Air One circles overhead, searchlight on the road, tyre smoke and NOS flames, twelve cars of traffic ahead, palms and the ocean to the west.
shots.title: Beach Chase

shots.scene: On-foot shootout in the Old Town market: the player crouched behind a bullet-holed barrier with Mara and Jax firing beside them, muzzle flashes and shell casings in the air, five NBPD officers and two SWAT advancing, an overturned cart, stalls and awnings in warm evening light.
shots.title: Market Battle

shots.scene: Inside the harbour vault: server racks with red PROTOTYPE LEDs, the hacking laptop mid-progress at node 3 of 4 with 0:47 on the clock, an eight-beam laser grid, crew at their stations, two spiderweb-cracked windows and a flashbang glare.
shots.title: Vault Heist

shots.scene: Two-deck highway escape at five stars: the hero car on the lower deck weaving through six swerving civilian cars, the police helicopter dead centre with its gunner in the open door, the roadblock on the upper deck — four cruisers, a spike strip and a Rhino tank — and the lit downtown skyline behind it.
shots.title: Highway Escape
